name: techdella/platform-badges
title: Platform badges
description: Row or grid of platforms we work in. Uses the official logo file from assets/img/logos/platforms/<slug>.svg|png when present, else the prototype's text badge (never a drawn logo).

techdella.help: Items: a known slug (google-search-console, ga4, semrush, wordpress-webflow, google-search, google-ads, meta, tiktok, linkedin, youtube, chatgpt, perplexity, google-ai-overviews, gemini, copilot, bing) or {"slug","name","mark","ink","note"}. Drop the official logo file into assets/img/logos/platforms/<slug>.svg to replace the text badge. A title turns the row into a full section; layout "grid" shows a card per platform with its note.
